correctness.rationale: Base W_2 is checked exactly. All eight off-boundary three-symbol windows avoid the two image words, giving unique phase decoding for length >=5 and exact occurrence bijection to shortest source cover. Endpoint deletions force any longer MUS to be a phase-two-to-phase-zero lift of a source MUS. Induction yields all five starts and common length for every m>=2. Independent suffix-array and exhaustive factor-counter calculations agree for finite m=2..9 and m=2..5, respectively; these are corroboration, not the infinity proof.

value.rationale: Identifies all MUS intervals, not just cardinality or experimental growth, in a natural nonperiodic automatic word singled out as a strongly interference-free example in contemporary substring-occurrence literature. The unexpected fixed cardinality five over all exponentially growing lengths, together with exact phases and positions, is a substantive structural classification motivated by the source paper’s explicit future research direction. Not a routine deduction of interference-freeness or a bounded test.
